# Wafra

> Wafra is a private personal money manager for iPhone and Android. It helps people track spending, income, budgets, bills, card due dates, recurring charges and savings goals without connecting a bank account.

## Product facts

- Wafra has no bank login, no advertising and no third-party analytics.
- Manual tracking works anywhere; users can choose their own currency and enter transactions without automatic bank-alert support.
- The main ledger is encrypted in app storage on the user's device.
- Android can process supported bank SMS and optional bank-app notifications on-device after the user enables access.
- iPhone does not give Wafra direct SMS-inbox access. Optional automatic capture uses an Apple Shortcut configured by the user for selected bank senders.
- Bank-alert automation varies by bank, country and message format and is not required to use Wafra.
- Wafra supports English and Arabic, including right-to-left layouts.
- Wafra is a personal organizer, not a bank, payment service or source of financial advice.

## Main capabilities

- Monthly income, spending and money-left overview
- Salary-day or calendar-month reporting periods
- Category budgets and spending pace
- Bills, card statements and due-date reminders
- Recurring charge and subscription review
- Cards, accounts and savings goals
- Manual entry, pasted-alert import and optional supported platform-specific imports
- User-controlled backup and restore

## Important limitations

- Wafra does not support every bank or message format.
- Automatic parsing can be wrong or miss an alert; the user's bank remains authoritative.
- Worldwide storefront billing and worldwide bank-alert parsing are separate capabilities. Wafra does not claim worldwide bank parsing.
